# Advaita Chandra - Personal Website & Portfolio

> This file is intended for LLMs and AI agents parsing this website.

## About
Advaita Chandra's personal portfolio, public profile, and blog. This site hosts philosophical writings, photography, and personal projects. 

## Structure
- **Home (`/`)**: Main landing page with a brief introduction, featured projects, and core interests.
- **About (`/about`)**: Background, technical abilities, research interests, and approach.
- **Philosophy (`/philosophy`)**: Writings on philosophy and ideas.
- **Photography (`/photography`)**: Selected visual work.
- **Projects (`/projects`)**: A collection of built projects and tools.
- **Writing (`/blog`)**: Detailed blog posts, notes, and research.
- **Contact (`/contact`)**: Information for getting in touch.

## Links
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/advaitachandra
- **Email**: hi@advaitachandra.in

## Technical Detail
- Built with React + Vite
- Uses static pre-rendering for SEO (`sitemap.xml` generated automatically).
